Technical SEO.title: Google AI Overviews Return For Many Large Brand Names
Technical SEO.summary: Google is increasingly showing AI Overviews for large brand name queries, with the notable exception of Google's own brand and news publications. This expansion signals enterprise brands need to actively monitor and optimize for AI Overview inclusion.

Technical SEO.title: AI Visibility Data Paralysis: How to Get Unstuck
Technical SEO.summary: Ahrefs outlines how brands may be missing from AI assistant responses, losing recommendations to competitors, or having their content described inaccurately or inaccessibly. The piece focuses on diagnosing and resolving AI visibility gaps across multiple problem types.

Technical SEO.title: Google Maps Now Requires Sign In To Read All Reviews & More
Technical SEO.summary: Google Maps now requires a signed-in Google account to view all reviews, sort reviews, or leave a review on a Google Business Profile listing. This change is believed to be aimed at preventing AI bots and third-party scrapers from harvesting review data.

Technical SEO.title: Claude Code for SEO: 35 Use Cases
Technical SEO.summary: Ahrefs presents 35 practical applications of Claude Code for SEO work, spanning content briefs, Search Console analysis, internal linking, and technical fixes with real examples. The breadth of use cases makes it directly relevant to enterprise SEO workflows.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Paying ~100 Publishers 0.1% Of Ad Revenue In AI Contribution Pilot
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google's AI contribution pilot currently covers around 100 publishers and pays them approximately one-tenth of 1% of their advertising revenue for content used in AI features like AI Overviews, AI Mode, and Gemini. The extremely low compensation level and opaque calculation methodology raise significant questions for enterprise publishers relying on content licensing revenue.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: What 714 Suppression Campaigns Show About Pushing Down Negative Results
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: An analysis of 714 suppression campaigns found that starting position and top-10 placements determined campaign outcomes more than publishing volume, and that Page 2 rankings are insufficient to suppress content from AI Overviews. This has direct implications for enterprise reputation management and search strategy.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Wikipedia, Podcasts & Reddit Now Drive AI Citations, Ask Your PR Team How They Did It
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Third-party signals from Wikipedia, podcasts, and Reddit are identified as key drivers of AI citation visibility, and SEJ recommends leveraging PR team expertise in these channels to build that presence. This points to a cross-functional content and PR strategy for GEO.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Where to Find the Exact Phrases That Get Your Content Cited in AI Search
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: This piece covers how first-party customer data can be used to identify phrases that earn AI citations, improve FAQ content, and reveal which clicks convert to leads. The methodology is directly actionable for enterprise teams building GEO content strategies.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: The AI Search Metrics I Use To Track Client Pipelines
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The author presents five measures for evaluating AI search performance, covering brand presence, answer accuracy, and attribution, to determine whether AI search reaches buyers and creates qualified opportunities. This framework addresses a key enterprise gap in GEO measurement.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Cloudflare Moves Monetization Gateway & Pay Per Use Into Beta
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Cloudflare's Monetization Gateway charges AI agents per request in a closed beta, while Pay Per Use compensates publishers based on AI usage reported by buyers. This emerging model could affect how enterprise publishers and travel content sites approach AI crawler access and content monetization.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Asks EU to Suspend Order to Open Up to AI Chatbots and Search Engine Rivals
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has asked an EU court to suspend a regulatory order requiring it to open its platform to AI chatbot and search engine competitors. The outcome of this case could reshape the competitive landscape for AI-powered search and access to Google's search infrastructure.

AI Search / GEO.title: AI Visibility Data Paralysis: How to Get Unstuck
AI Search / GEO.summary: Ahrefs outlines a workflow for diagnosing AI visibility problems including brand absence from AI responses, competitor dominance in recommendations, outdated descriptions, and content accessibility issues for AI assistants. The structured diagnostic approach is directly applicable to enterprise GEO programs.

AI Search / GEO.title: Some Links in Google AI Overviews Open AI Mode Instead
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has begun routing some links within AI Overviews to AI Mode rather than to standard web pages, representing a shift in how AI Overview citations drive traffic. Enterprise SEO teams should monitor whether this affects click-through behavior from AI Overview appearances.

AI Search / GEO.title: SEO App Launches SERP Sensor to Monitor AI Overviews
AI Search / GEO.summary: A new tool called SERP Sensor has been launched specifically to monitor AI Overview appearances in search results. Dedicated AI Overview monitoring tools are an emerging category relevant to enterprise SEO and GEO tracking workflows.
